title: Split ordered restriction for module sheaves
statement: Let $X',T'$ be schemes and $f':X'\to T'$ a morphism. Let $M$ be a module sheaf on $X'$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $W_i$, $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$, any finite family of opens. Let $K$ be an integer cochain complex of module sheaves on $T'$ with zero negative terms. Suppose for all nonnegative $p$ and opens $B\subset T'$ there are additive equivalences $a_{p,B}:\Gamma(B,K^p)\simeq\prod_t\Gamma((\bigcap_lW_{t(l)})\cap(f')^{-1}B,M)$ indexed by increasing $(p+1)$-tuples [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex]. Assume these equivalences commute with restrictions of $B$, take multiplication by $b\in\Gamma(B,\mathcal O_{T'})$ to multiplication by the restriction of $(f')^*b$ on each coordinate, and intertwine $d_K$ with the signed face-restriction sum. Let $D$ be a nonnegative cochain complex of module sheaves on $X'$. Suppose its terms, after forgetting to presheaves of global-ring modules, are identified by natural isomorphisms $e_p$ with the usual all-tuple Cech terms of $W,M$. Assume $e$ intertwines differentials, and each coordinate on an open $C\subset X'$ takes multiplication by $b\in\Gamma(C,\mathcal O_{X'})$ to multiplication by its restriction to $(\bigcap_lW_{y(l)})\cap C$. Let $L=(f'_*D)^{\mathrm{ext}}$ and let $q$ be its ordered coordinate maps [def-pc-ordered-cech-module-coordinates]. There exist cochain maps $R:L\to K$ and $I:K\to L$ of module sheaves such that $R\circ I=\mathrm{id}_K$ and $a_{p,B,t}(R(s))=q_{p,B,t}(s)$ for every nonnegative degree, base open, section and increasing tuple. No covering assumption is made.

proof.text: Obtain R with its ordered coordinate formula from orderedCech_module_restriction, and independently obtain I with q(I(s))=a(s) from orderedCech_module_signedSection.

In degree p >= 0 and on each B, apply injectivity of a p B and evaluate at t. The coordinate formula for R, evaluated on I(s), followed by the coordinate formula for I gives a(R(I(s))) t = q(I(s)) t = a(s) t. Extensionality of module-sheaf morphisms proves the identity in this degree. In negative degrees K is a zero object by hK, so the two maps out of K agree. Complex-morphism extensionality proves I followed by R is identity; retain the coordinate formula for R.

proof_origin.note: Independent ordered restriction and signed-extension coordinate equations imply the retraction by injectivity and degreewise extensionality.

theorem orderedCech_module_retraction {X' T' : Scheme.{u}} (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex T'.Modules ℤ) (hK : K.IsStrictlyGE 0)
    (a : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : T'.Opens),
      Γ(K.X (p : ℤ), B) ≃+
        (∀ t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r,
          Γ(M, alternatingCechIntersection (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) t ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B)))
    (hn : ∀ (p : ℕ) {B C : T'.Opens} (i : B ⟶ C)
        (s : Γ(K.X (p : ℤ), C)) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
      a p B ((K.X (p : ℤ)).presheaf.map i.op s) t =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf le_rfl
          ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f'.base).map i).le)).op (a p C s t))
    (hl : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : T'.Opens) (b : Γ(T', B))
        (s : Γ(K.X (p : ℤ), B)) (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
      a p B (b • s) t =
        X'.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show
          alternatingCechIntersection (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) t ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B
            from inf_le_right)).op (f'.app B b) • a p B s t)
    (ha : ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : T'.Opens) (s : Γ(K.X (p : ℤ), B))
        (t : Fin (p + 2) ↪o Fin r),
      a (p + 1) B ((K.d (p : ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).app B s) t =
        ∑ j : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ j.val •
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf
            (alternatingCechIntersection_face_le (fun i ↦ W₀ ⟨i⟩) p t j) le_rfl)).op
              (a p B s ((Fin.succAboveOrderEmb j).trans t)))
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s) :
    ∃ (rmap : ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ⟶ K) (imap : K
        ⟶ ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)),
      imap ≫ rmap = 𝟙 K ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (B : T'.Opens) (s : Γ(
        ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat).X (p : ℤ), B))
        (t : Fin (p + 1) ↪o Fin r),
        a p B ((rmap.f (p : ℤ)).app B s) t =
          orderedCechModuleCoordinate f' M W₀ D e p B t s
